patch_description:
The current baseline is pure LFU with all network listeners disabled, which the system note explicitly states underperforms MGLRU. I will enable network monitoring and adapt eviction decisions based on real-time network conditions.

Key changes:
1. Enable EWMA listener for RTT (GF_SRTT_US) to detect network degradation - when RTT is high, each cache miss is expensive so we should protect hot pages more aggressively
2. Enable MinMax for loss detection (GF_LOST) - any loss indicates congestion, warrant more conservative eviction
3. Enable EWMA for cwnd (GF_SND_CWND) to track congestion state
4. Enable EWMA for inter-arrival time (GF_INTER_ARRIVAL) to detect request bursts
5. Enable per-folio interval EWMA tracking to distinguish truly hot folios from one-shot accesses
6. Enhance scoring function to:
   - Amplify protection (add bonus) when RTT is elevated (network-bound = expensive misses)
   - Add bonus when loss is detected (congestion = protect working set)
   - Add bonus for hot folios (low interval EWMA = frequent re-access)
   - Add recency bonus (recently accessed = likely in working set)
   - Keep LevelDB index block protection

The scoring logic: higher score = keep longer (kernel picks minimum). Start with access_count, then add bonuses based on network state and per-folio heat.
